title: Learning Adaptive SED for heterogeneous load balancing
abstract: arXiv:2609.06881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a two-server load balancing system with heterogeneous service rates that are a priori unknown to the dispatcher. The goal is to route customers according to the Shortest--Expected--Delay (SED) policy, but this requires knowledge of the service rates. Empirical policies that route based on estimates perform poorly: due to estimation error, the empirical policy disagrees with the oracle on an infinite region of the state space. We propose an online learning algorithm that converges to SED while learning the service rates. The algorithm carefully balances empirical SED routing with forced exploration phases that guarantee sufficient sampling of both servers. We prove that our algorithm achieves finite regret; this differs from classical Multi-Armed Bandit settings where regret typically grows logarithmically in time. translated_title: 面向异构负载均衡的学习型自适应SED（最短期望延迟）策略
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个具有异构服务速率的两服务器负载均衡系统，调度器事先并不知道这些服务速率。目标是按照最短期望延迟策略来路由顾客，但这需要预先知道服务速率。基于估计的经验型路由策略表现不佳：由于估计误差，经验策略在状态空间的一个无限区域上会与先知策略产生分歧。我们提出了一种在线学习算法，能够在学习服务速率的同时收敛到SED策略。该算法精心平衡了经验SED路由与强制探索阶段，从而保证对两个服务器都进行充分采样。我们证明该算法实现了有限遗憾，这与经典多臂老虎机问题中遗憾通常随时间对数增长的特性形成鲜明对比。最后，数值实验展示了我们算法的性能，并突出了强制探索起作用的运行区间。
tldr: 针对服务速率未知的异构两服务器负载均衡系统，提出了一种在线学习SED路由算法，通过平衡经验路由与强制探索阶段，首次实现了有限遗憾（而非经典多臂老虎机中的对数增长遗憾）。
en_tdlr: We propose an online learning algorithm for heterogeneous two-server load balancing that converges to the SED policy while learning unknown service rates, achieving finite regret—unlike classical multi-armed bandit settings where regret grows logarithmically in time.
